title: Counterexamples to Sato's Weak F-Equivalence Conjecture and a Gorenstein Refinement
summary: We disprove Sato's weak \(F\)-equivalence conjecture for nonsingular projective toric weak Fano varieties in every dimension \(d \geq 3\). Our counterexamples are smooth projective crepant models of centered reflexive simplices. The key input is a rigidity property of ray polytopes: if \(X_Σ\) is nonsingular and complete and \(-K_{X_Σ}\) is nef, then every nonzero lattice point of \(P_Σ=\operatorname{Conv}(G(Σ))\) is a primitive ray generator.
